scientific_integrity: Exact finite spectrum is acknowledged prior work. New claim is strict monotonicity and the sharp large-orbit theta threshold; no independent validation or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only analytic Gaussian Bargmann–Fock kernels at equally spaced points; fixed squared condition target, no uniform error rate, no arbitrary-arrangement optimality, no independent scientific or publication-priority audit. Known finite Poisson-residue eigenvalues explicitly attributed to Horoshko et al. (2016).
title: Sharp theta-function conditioning threshold for circular Fock kernels
